summary: Verified production startup guardrails and preview regression for STOIC AI bot. All 3 simulations produced the expected outcomes (crash with correct RuntimeError for missing CSRF/ORIGINS, crash for weak ADMIN_PASSWORD, clean boot + 200 health with full checklist). Preview backend on port 8001 remained healthy and admin login with admin@stoicaibot.com/admin123 still returns 200 (seed_admin is idempotent). No stray processes left on 8061-8063.
action_items: Production rollout: set the full env checklist on the origin server before restart — APP_ENV=production, CSRF_ENFORCE_ORIGIN=true, CORS_ORIGINS='https://stoicaibot.com,https://www.stoicaibot.com', a strong ADMIN_PASSWORD (default admin123 is refused), and (if used) STEP_UP_BYPASS_TOKEN/RATE_LIMIT_BYPASS_TOKEN empty or set. Missing any of these crash-loops uvicorn and Cloudflare shows 'empty response'.
critical_code_review_comments: Guardrails in server.py on_startup work as designed (fail-fast with clear RuntimeError messages).
seed_admin is correctly idempotent — preview admin password admin123 was NOT reset after 3 production-config boots against the same Mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Simulation evidence captured:
- SIM1 (port 8061, no CSRF_ENFORCE_ORIGIN): exited with 'RuntimeError: APP_ENV=production requires CSRF_ENFORCE_ORIGIN=true and an explicit CORS_ORIGINS allowlist (not empty, not \'*\').' ✓
- SIM2 (port 8062, weak password): exited with 'RuntimeError: APP_ENV=production requires a strong ADMIN_PASSWORD (the default \'admin123\' is refused).' ✓
- SIM3 (port 8063, full checklist + ADMIN_PASSWORD=<redacted>): 'Application startup complete.' and GET /api/health → 200 {"status":"ok","db":"connected"} ✓ (process killed afterwards).
- Preview regression (supervisor backend, REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL): /api/health 200, POST /api/auth/login admin@stoicaibot.com/admin123 → 200 with role=admin.
- Cleanup: no stray uvicorns on 8061-8063.
No code or .env changes were made this iteration.
rca of the issue: Cloudflare 'origin sent an empty response' at www.stoicaibot.com/login was caused by the production uvicorn process crash-looping during startup because APP_ENV=production was set without the accompanying required env vars (CSRF_ENFORCE_ORIGIN, CORS_ORIGINS, strong ADMIN_PASSWORD). nginx therefore had no upstream, so Cloudflare received an empty/malformed response. Reproduced deterministically in SIM1 & SIM2; fixed deterministically in SIM3 by setting the full checklist. Mitigation: apply the production secrets checklist listed in action_items on the origin host and restart the backend service.
